svg.title: Vitalii Borovyk's GitHub contributions as a 3D skyline: 8,647 contributions · Oct 2025 – Oct 2026
svg.desc: One block per day, 369 days in two rows of weeks, older weeks at the back. Height uses a square-root scale. Days above 264 contributions are drawn at the cap height; the busiest day, 2026-09-29, had 414.
